
---mode: agentdescription: Batch 11e. Calmer Review rows, a step-by-step Import, and tidier People and Settle. Markup only. About 45K tokens.---
Build batch 11e only. Markup and wording only. No new rules, no data changes, and no CSS. The class list is in `11d-ui-shell-wording.prompt.md`, under "Classes available". Read only that section. `more-menu` is a `details` element: its `summary` is a `secondary` button, and the menu is a `div` of buttons after it.
Read: `.github/prompts/PROGRESS.md`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ImportView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/PeopleView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SettleView.tsx`.
## Build
1. Review row actions.   - Visible: one `primary` action (Spend for money out, Income for money in), then "Skip" (`secondary`).   - Everything else goes in a `more-menu` "More": Transfer, Settlement, and Refund (money in only).   - Close the menu after a choice.2. Review suggestions and forms. Open these in a full-width row under the bank row: `<tr className="row-detail"><td colSpan={5}>`. Never put them inside the actions cell. One open at a time:   - The spend form, the refund form, and the manual transfer picker.   - A transfer suggestion, as text: "Looks like a transfer {to or from} {account} on {d Mon}. {amount}." Then "Confirm transfer" (`primary`) and "Not a transfer" (`secondary`, which dismisses it). Self and House pairs then ask "Contribution (no one owes anything)" or "Settlement (pays back what House owes)".   - The card cycle line, as `hint` text: "Card payments this cycle: $x. Difference $y. This may be interest or a fee."3. Review heading: `h1` "Review" with the waiting count, "{n} to review". When nothing is waiting, the empty state says "All caught up."4. Import, as a `steps` list inside a `card`.   - 1 "Choose the account".   - 2 "Choose the CSV file".   - 3 "Check the format": the mapping select, "Suggested" beside suggested presets, and "New format" in a `text-button`.   - 4 "Check the rows": the preview table, with "{n} new, {m} already imported" above it.   - Mark each `li` `done` as the user finishes it.   - The heading's `primary` button reads "Import {n} rows", and is disabled until step 4.   - Under the history checkbox, add a `hint`: "Use this for old statements. The rows appear in reports but do not change who owes what."   - Duplicate and error messages are banners.5. `PeopleView.tsx`.   - Order: the people table first. Then a "Add person or group" `card` with Name, Kind, and Add on one row. Remove the duplicate heading button, or make it focus the Name input.   - Splitwise moves to its own `card` below, with a `section-heading` "Splitwise" and a status line: "Not connected", or "Connected as {name}".   - The key field and Connect show only when not connected.   - Link controls show in the table only when connected, as one select and a Link button.   - Kind shows as a chip.6. `SettleView.tsx`.   - The form comes first, in a `card`: Who, Direction ("They paid me" or "I paid them"), Amount, Date, Note, then Record (`primary`).   - The balance card sits above it, in plain words.   - "Payment allocation" shows only when an amount is entered.   - Empty open-item tables collapse to one `muted` line: "Nothing open."

None.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. In `npm run dev`, with made-up data, check one Review row through each path (spend, More, then transfer, then skip), and one import. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 12.
